settings.title: System
settings.description:
Inverters found: {detected}. Prices are used for the savings in Totals.

Inverter order: which inverter of the source goes in each column. With Solar Assistant numbering them 1, 2, 3 by USB port, "1,3,2" shows its inverter 3 in the second column.

manual.description: Choose the sensors to use. Power in W (battery: positive while charging), energy counters in kWh.
